module_summary: Wraps a sticky-overflow delta counter and tracks its running maximum in a register, with a sticky flag recording overflow at the maximum.

anchors.name: max_q
anchors.why: Register holding the maximum counter value seen so far; updated when q_o exceeds it.

anchors.name: q_o
anchors.why: Current count output from child counter; compared against max_q to update the maximum.

anchors.name: max_o
anchors.why: Maximum value output, bypassing the new value when q_o exceeds max_q.

anchors.name: overflow_max_o
anchors.why: Sticky flag output: counter overflowed while setting a new maximum.

anchors.name: overflow_o
anchors.why: Sticky overflow from the child counter; sets overflow_max_d when a new maximum is recorded.

anchors.name: en_i
anchors.why: Enables the child counter to step by delta each cycle.

anchors.name: load_i
anchors.why: Loads d_i into the child counter.

anchors.name: down_i
anchors.why: Selects down counting in the child counter.

anchors.name: delta_i
anchors.why: Step size applied by the child counter.

anchors.name: d_i
anchors.why: Load value for the child counter.

groups.name: delta_counter
groups.description: Child up/down delta counter with sticky overflow, cleared by clr_i or clr_cnt_i.

groups.name: max_tracker
groups.description: Compares q_o with max_q, records new maximum and overflow-at-maximum sticky flag.
